scenes.stage_direction: Calls and protected interviews interrupt the search. Amara asks practical questions about Ethan's care before she asks about blame.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: She left a note. She was afraid of the man coming to collect Ethan.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: She was afraid, and she still let him take my son?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: A witness saw her change vehicles. We can follow what happened next.

metadata.evidence_summary: She left a note expressing fear of Ethan's collector.
